column3: With respect to the ExchangeRight Net Leased Portfolio #72 Mortgage Loan (3.6%), the borrower may rely on insurance obtained by the tenants of the Mortgaged Properties, provided that such insurance meets the requirements of the Mortgage Loan documents, the tenant’s provision of insurance is in compliance with its lease and certain other conditions are satisfied. If a tenant’s insurance does not meet such requirements, the borrower must maintain sufficient insurance, when coupled with the tenant’s insurance, to meet the requirements of the Mortgage Loan documents.
